title: Variational Monte Carlo for Quantum Excited States via Nested Low-Rank Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21434v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The electronic Schr\"odinger equation encodes a molecule's electronic structure and quantum properties, but solving it scales exponentially with the number of electrons. Solving this equation with neural-network variational Monte Carlo (VMC) has reached chemical accuracy on the ground state of small molecules; extending this success to excited states is constrained by two existing paradigms. Penalty-based methods need $K$ Laplacians per step but require tuning the overlap-penalty weights against the energy gaps they aim to compute. Natural excited states VMC (NES-VMC) is penalty-free, but it combines the $K$ ansatzes into one determinant, whose local energy requires $K^2$ Laplacians per step. We resolve this trade-off via low-rank approximation (LoRA) reparameterization of the rank-$K$ variational objective. translated_title: 基于嵌套低秩近似的量子激发态变分蒙特卡洛方法
translated_abstract: 电子薛定谔方程编码了分子的电子结构和量子性质，但求解该方程的计算复杂度随电子数目呈指数级增长。利用神经网络变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）求解该方程已在小分子基态上达到化学精度；然而，将这一成功扩展到激发态受到两种现有范式的制约。基于罚函数的方法每步需要 K 次拉普拉斯算子计算，但还需要针对其旨在计算的能隙来调节重叠罚权重。自然激发态 VMC（NES-VMC）无需罚函数，但它将 K 个拟设组合为一个行列式，其局部能量每步需要 K² 次拉普拉斯算子计算。我们通过对秩为 K 的变分目标进行低秩近似（LoRA）重参数化来解决这一权衡。重参数化后的目标可以通过从各态的玻恩密度进行 MCMC 采样，得到与 VMC 兼容的随机梯度估计器（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出通过对变分蒙特卡洛中秩为 K 的变分目标进行嵌套低秩近似（LoRA）重参数化，解决了现有激发态计算方法中拉普拉斯算子计算开销与罚权重调节之间的权衡问题，实现了高效的量子激发态求解。
en_tdlr: This paper resolves the trade-off between Laplacian computation cost and overlap-penalty weight tuning in existing quantum excited-state VMC methods via nested low-rank approximation (LoRA) reparameterization of the rank-K variational objective.
